description: ChromaDB retrieval quality evaluation dataset for the USC course catalogue. Covers semantic search, career-goal queries, metadata-filter lookups, and edge cases.

sets.1: Known course lookups — specific natural-language queries that should reliably surface a single target course in top-k results.
sets.2: Career goal queries — open-ended queries reflecting real student use cases. No ground-truth output yet; scores will be assigned by an LLM evaluator.
sets.3: Elective pool metadata lookups — direct class_code filter via ChromaDB where clause to verify ingestion completeness for known elective candidates.
sets.4: Edge cases — probes department coverage, category diversity, and ingestion quality for courses that are commonly mis-indexed or missing.

items.note: Query includes both course code and name — strongest signal; should be rank 1.
Generic term — tests that canonical CS core courses surface without a course code hint.
Single-word query — broad term shared across many courses; CSCI-270 must outrank generic mentions.
Cross-department query (ITP, not CSCI) — tests that non-CSCI relevant courses are indexed and retrieved.
Should surface ML/AI courses (CSCI-467, CSCI-499, CSCI-445, EE-451). LLM evaluator to score relevance.
Should surface systems/OS/networking courses. LLM evaluator to score relevance.
Cross-domain query — should surface MATH-458 and finance/probability courses alongside CS. Tests cross-dept retrieval.
Should surface CSCI-420, CSCI-445, CSCI-467. LLM evaluator to score relevance.
Should surface networking, OS, and systems-level courses. LLM evaluator to score relevance.
Should surface ITP and CSCI web/software engineering courses. LLM evaluator to score relevance.
Should surface CSCI-467, CSCI-544, and related AI courses. LLM evaluator to score relevance.

Exact metadata match — verifies CSCI-445 ingestion.
Exact metadata match — verifies CSCI-420 ingestion.
Cross-dept check — TAC courses are less common in CS planning contexts; verifies they were scraped and stored.

Tests MATH dept coverage in semantic search — a common omission if scraping skipped math pages.

ENGR-395 has multiple variants (a, b, etc. suffixes stripped during ingestion). Evaluator should check that at least one ENGR-395 variant is in results.
Broad term shared across many courses — CSCI-499 (Directed Research) must appear. Also validates that other research-type courses (490, 495 variants) are present in broader results.
